workflow_synthesis.evidence_axis: G_scenario_coverage: broaden hidden-fault discovery coverage before objective design
workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: pre-registers a broader fault taxonomy and v2 discovery config after M704/M707 reset-only evidence and M713 actor-head coupling positive evidence
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: design and config readiness only; no new closed-loop source-positive claim and no checkpoint promotion
stop_condition: stop claiming complete fault coverage if requested faults require four-wheel or high-fidelity dynamics
stop current-model-only mining if M716 again yields reset-only or history-insensitive evidence across the v2 taxonomy
stop actor objective design if full-coverage discovery shows no action or outcome sensitivity after matched-history interventions
fallback_plan: if v2 current-model proxies remain reset-only, pivot to four-wheel or external-yaw-disturbance model design
if v2 produces source-positive wrong-history rows, export a source-balanced corpus before any actor update
if v2 produces feature/action signal but no outcome signal, return to actor-head residual objective design with v2 rows
if all severe cases fail normal history, lower severity or move obstacle timing earlier rather than training on impossible rows
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: new branch after M714 promote_to_next_branch decision

hypothesis: The project may not have mined enough extreme hidden-condition coverage; a broader current-model/proxy fault taxonomy can reveal matched-history intervention rows that M704/M707 did not expose.
success_criteria: M715 documents the coverage gap hypothesis and model-fidelity boundary
M715 adds a validated v2 fault coverage config

design omits normal reset wrong or delayed-history interventions
design admits actor update PPO or promotion before data generation
